## "file_format"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
The file extension of the asset file. Example "tif".

**Description of metadata field:**  
The format of the main asset file(s). This means that it is possible for an asset to have a minor text file attached to it that will not be part of this. 

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Ingestion server will set this when the asset metadata is created.

**Updated where and when:**  
If an error is discovered during auditing or processing. This will likely be handled manually by a user in in the dassco ui.

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
file_formats

**Maps to in Specify:**  
File format [mimeType]

**Notes and issues:**  
Name mapping issue "file_format" to "file_formats". We are using a single value in lower case. ARS is using a list of values all in upper case that must come from a enum list. Specify is using a single value I think. What happens if assets can have thumbnails (jpegs) added to them?PB: If an asset has thumbnails added to them, these should not be included in the file_format.We accept the current discrepancy  with the expectation that an asset cannot be composed of multiple file formats (21-1-25).
